coaching.headline: Two takes of the enemy mid inhibitor went nowhere: no Core push, five deaths for Orb Prime, then the allied Core fell.

flags.text: Orb Prime cost five damn lives: three to Crunch, two to Lt. Belica; the allied Core fell next.
The enemy mid inhibitor fell twice, Scarlett destroying the second, and the enemy Core was never hit.
A nine-kill lead never turned into gold, 95.5k to 103.5k; only three of seven won fights got cashed.
Scarlett's ten deaths were the game's most: four to Lt. Belica, three to Crunch, none to Greystone.

focus.title: Inhibitor down means Core next
focus.action: With an enemy inhibitor down, the next won fight goes to the Core with all five; Orb Prime waits until Crunch and Lt. Belica are seen, and Scarlett follows Steel's engage into fights.

39.6.call: Lost 0-5 in the window the allies took Orb Prime: Crunch killed Steel in the enemy jungle first, then Legion and Scarlett at the Prime pit. Once the frontline drops first, leave the pit.

29.4.call: Won 4-2 around the Fangtooth pit with kills from Legion, Steel and Gadget; the enemy mid inner and mid inhibitor both fell to the allies right after. The conversion to repeat.

25.9.call: Won 3-0 on the enemy mid lane, yet the allied offlane inner fell in the same window. Before committing to mid, check whether Crunch is pushing the offlane.

36.2.call: Two separate plays, lost 1-3: Greystone razed the allied offlane inhibitor and fell to Steel, and Morigesh and Gadget died in the minute before the second enemy Primal Fangtooth. Regroup before that pit.

31.7.call: The enemy took Primal Fangtooth with no ally dead; the 3-1 win that followed took no tower, only the Genesis Core later. After a win like that, test the nearest enemy tower.

cbbac1bf-8799-40e8-9cd9-23f1fc24a7eb: Destroyed the enemy mid inner after the 4-2 Fangtooth-pit win; 10.7 CS per minute on an 8.8 norm. With the enemy mid outer down, rotate to duo fights.
Two of four deaths to Sparrow, one outside any detected fight on the enemy mid lane before an enemy Primal Fangtooth. Siege beside Legion or Steel while Sparrow is unseen.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Ran the vision: 31 wards on a 17.5 norm, the game's most, and 72% kill participation. Keep that volume and place late wards around the Prime pit before Orb Prime.
Zero enemy wards cleared while the enemy cleared 11. If a sentry is equipped next game, sweep the Fangtooth and Prime pits before each take.
Five deaths against a norm under four: first blood to Sparrow, and the opening death of the Orb Prime fight to Crunch. When Crunch is unseen late, hold the engage.
57cbb699-4895-46ca-95a1-1016c6c36047: Two deaths against a norm above four and 9.5 CS per minute on a 5.9 norm, plus three kills on Greystone. Keep that survival and farm as the standard.
Crunch destroyed the allied offlane outer tower. When Crunch and Greystone both show on the offlane, call Scarlett over before the next tower drops.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Damn good carrying: 47588 hero damage and twelve kills, both game highs, three on the enemy mid lane before the enemy duo outer fell. When mid fights, repeat that rotation.
Two of five deaths to Lt. Belica on the duo lane, one in the 0-2 bad trade that also killed Scarlett. Without Steel nearby, back off when Lt. Belica shows.
2d09e8cb-ddf2-464f-aab4-de733f3e0283: Destroyed the enemy mid inhibitor, then died to Sparrow on the enemy mid lane. After razing an inhibitor, back off to the team before Sparrow can answer.
Out-earned Greystone 18.8k to 14.7k in gold. Spend that lead on the enemy camps while Lt. Belica shows on another lane.

matchup: Ikra was the lane opponent; Ikra killed Gadget once and Gadget killed Ikra once.
Gadget out-damaged Ikra 42694 to 34896 in hero damage, while Ikra out-earned Gadget 20977 gold to 20105.
build: Entropy is the one winning-core item built; Azure Core and Overseer, from the 58.1% core, never made the build.
Soulbinder's Arcane Salvo adds bonus damage only on ability hits from long range.
eternal: Vesh repeats a share of ability damage on enemy heroes as damage over time; Mind Rot adds current-health damage.
Aion leans ahead of Vesh, the most played, in the Gadget midlane field.
Tithe of Death with Mind Rot is the best Vesh pair; the Lich and Mind Rot run ranks third.
augment: Auto-Lock Amp raises Seek and Destroy's homing speed by 25%.
Auto-Lock Amp is clearly the field's best Gadget midlane augment. Sound keep.
crest: Epoch's Stasis Device active enters Stasis for 2.5s.
Epoch and Soulbearer are a toss-up in the Gadget midlane field; Epoch has the best odds. Sound keep.
improvement: Aion over Vesh is the field-backed Eternal test: mana regeneration and gold from spell damage, giving up the damage over time.
Tithe of Death over Lich swaps magical lifesteal for takedown mana and ability haste.

matchup: Duo was Legion and Steel against Sparrow and Lt. Belica; each duo lost one life before minute ten.
Lt. Belica killed Steel twice, and Lt. Belica's 10 kills trailed only Legion's 12.
Force Shield destroys enemy projectiles, cover against the ranged Sparrow and Lt. Belica.
build: None of the 58.1% winning core, Xenia, Dynamo and Gaia Greaves, made the build.
Tainted Charm cuts nearby enemy healing by 45% and slows 12%, useful into Crunch's 23080 healing, the game's most.
Stonewall mitigates a share of physical damage into a comp with three physical damage dealers.
eternal: Krix raises maximum health with level and adds bonus size.
Idrisil and Krix are a toss-up in the Steel support field; Idrisil has the best odds.
Regenerative Tissue with Cannibalism is the best Krix pair. Sound keep on minors.
augment: Heavy Metal adds bonus magical damage to Heavy Punches and Shield Bash, scaled by total armor.
Heavy Metal is the most played Steel support augment and the only one with enough games to lead.
crest: Leafsong's Phantom Rush speeds nearby allies and grants slow immunity; Visionary raises the ward cap to three.
Leafsong and Rift Walkers are a toss-up for the lead; Leafsong has the best odds. Sound keep.
improvement: Idrisil over Krix is the toss-up test: bonus armor and a low-health shield instead of bonus maximum health.
Xenia, from the winning core, shields nearby allies, giving up Fire Blossom's burn.

matchup: Crunch was the lane opponent; Morigesh killed Crunch once, and Crunch killed Morigesh once in the enemy jungle.
Crunch's RMB dash stuns, and the passive on Re-Crunch heals on every third hit.
Crunch mitigated 76666 damage, the game's most, and out-earned Morigesh 23159 gold to 19318.
build: Megacosm is the one winning-core item built; Combustion and Lifebinder, from the 45% core, never made the build.
Tainted Scepter cuts healing 45% for 4s on any magical damage, an answer to Crunch's healing.
Prophecy, the last item finished, adds magical on-hit damage to basic attacks.
eternal: Krix raises maximum health and size; Voracity heals on unit kills, and Cannibalism adds health per takedown.
Krix has too few Morigesh offlane games to rank; Vesh and Aion are a toss-up, Vesh with the best odds.
Lich with Mind Rot is the best Vesh pair.
augment: Cursed Infestation gives Hive 10% more damage and 10% more range.
Cursed Infestation, Ritual Of Death and Spirit Shred are a toss-up; Cursed Infestation has the best odds. Sound keep.
crest: Nyr Warboots' Resilience active grants decaying movement speed and health regeneration.
Nyr Warboots has no recorded Morigesh offlane games; Epoch and Soulbearer are a toss-up, Epoch with the best odds.
Nyr Warboots evolves from Goliath Crest; Epoch from Wizard Crest.
improvement: Vesh with Lich and Mind Rot over Krix trades health stacking for ability damage over time and magical lifesteal.
Epoch over Nyr Warboots trades the speed and regeneration burst for a Stasis active and magical power.

matchup: Legion killed Sparrow four times, and Sparrow never killed Legion.
Sparrow's 22292 objective damage beat Legion's 16825, and Sparrow destroyed the allied duo outer tower.
build: Spear Of Desolation is the one winning-core item built; Malady and Deathstalker, from the 58.9% core, never made the build.
Mutilator deals max-health damage on basic attacks, and ability hits on heroes apply the effect three times.
Vanquisher executes a hero taken below 5% health.
eternal: Xyris adds bonus damage that grows with units killed.
Xyris is clearly the field's best Legion carry Eternal. Sound keep.
Iron Will with Bone Collector is the best Xyris pair. Sound keep.
augment: Press the Advantage spawns a Rally Point at each takedown, raising rate of fire and granting allies attack speed.
Scorched Earth leans ahead of Press the Advantage, the most played, in the Legion carry field.
crest: Exodus's Eviction Grenade pierces enemy units, stuns briefly and launches enemy heroes back.
Ortus is clearly the field's best Legion carry crest; Exodus has too few games to lead.
Exodus evolves from Sharpshooter Crest; Ortus from Assassin Crest.
improvement: Scorched Earth over Press the Advantage adds napalm zones from Frag Order, mines and Orbital Sanction, giving up takedown Rally Points.
Ortus over Exodus trades the knockback grenade for movement speed and physical power that takedowns refresh.

matchup: Greystone was the jungle opponent; Scarlett killed Greystone twice, and Greystone never killed Scarlett.
Lt. Belica took four Scarlett deaths; Lt. Belica's Q stuns and R silences.
Greystone's Q shreds physical armor, and the passive deflects a basic attack on a cooldown.
build: None of the 55% winning core, Alternator, Solaris and Vanquisher, made the build.
No armor item into three physical damage dealers; Rebirth, the last item finished, resurrects after dying.
Nightfall heals for a share of ability damage to heroes and shields on takedowns.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles after damaging a hero below 30% health.
Xyris, Knell and Weald are a toss-up in the Scarlett jungle field; Xyris has the best odds.
Forage with Wind-Rider is the most picked Weald pair; no pair has enough games to rank.
augment: Volcaic Slam: Empowered Cindara leaves a rupture that erupts for damage and a 40% slow.
Volcaic Slam and Scarlet Dawn are a toss-up; Volcaic Slam has the best odds. Sound keep.
crest: Eviscerator's Rending Strikes active grants attack speed, omnivamp and bonus basic-attack damage.
Iceskorn Talons leans ahead in the Scarlett jungle field; Eviscerator has too few games to be ranked.
Eviscerator evolves from Sharpshooter Crest; Iceskorn Talons from Champion Crest.
improvement: Iceskorn Talons over Eviscerator trades the Rending Strikes burst for an ice sheet that boosts allied power and slows enemies.
Xyris over Weald is the best-odds Eternal test: scaling bonus damage instead of low-health missiles.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.8s of lockdown): Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Dive threat on our backline: Crunch. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Mark a target → Hive slow → Swarm reposition → Curse execute-burst ult
ourKits.winCondition: Mark + Curse a squishy and delete them with %max-HP Pestilence
ourKits.playWith: setup that holds her marked target
ourKits.playAgainst: she's squishy with one escape (Swarm) — dive after it's used; spread vs Hive

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
enemyKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
enemyKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
enemyKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down
